name: HDMI cable flag
description: Wrap-around flag for HDMI cables (the switch-input flags): face, a wrap zone round the cable, face. Wrap the middle band round the cable, then stick the two faces back to back. Defaults give 3 flags per label.

fields.label: Names, one per line
fields.hint: Each name gets its own label piece

fields.label: Along the cable (mm)
fields.hint: Shorter is easier where the cable bends

fields.label: Flag depth (mm)
fields.hint: How far the flag hangs off the cable

fields.label: Copies of each
fields.hint: 2 = one for each end of the cable
